# Mocked data
books = [
    {"id": 1, "title": "1984", "author": "George Orwell", "available": False},
    {"id": 2, "title": "Brave New World", "author": "Aldous Huxley", "available": True},
    {"id": 3, "title": "The Great Gatsby", "author": "F. Scott Fitzgerald", "available": True},
    {"id": 4, "title": "Animal Farm", "author": "George Orwell", "available": True}
]

members = [
    {"id": 101, "name": "Alice", "checked_out": [1]},
    {"id": 102, "name": "Bob", "checked_out": []},
    {"id": 103, "name": "Charlie", "checked_out": [2, 4]}
]

# Mocked functions
def get_books_by_author(author: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return all books by a specific author"""
    return [book for book in books if book["author"] == author]

def check_availability(book_id: int) -> bool:
    """Check if a book is available"""
    book = next((b for b in books if b["id"] == book_id), None)
    return book["available"] if book else False

def get_member_checked_out(member_id: int) -> list[int]:
    """Get list of checked-out book IDs for a member"""
    member = next((m for m in members if m["id"] == member_id), None)
    return member["checked_out"] if member else []

def has_overdue_books(member_id: int) -> bool:
    """Check if member has any overdue books (mock logic)"""
    # Mock: Members with even IDs have no overdue books
    return member_id % 2 != 0

def calculate_overdue_fine(member_id: int) -> int:
    """Calculate total overdue fines in dollars (mock logic)"""
    # Mock: Fixed fine based on member ID
    return 15 if member_id in [101, 102] else 0

from typing import TypedDict, List

class Employee(TypedDict):
    id: int
    name: str
    role: str
    department: str
    salary: float

class Project(TypedDict):
    id: int
    name: str
    department: str
    budget: float
    spent: float
    status: str

employees: List[Employee] = [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "role": "Manager", "department": "Sales", "salary": 120000},
    {"id": 2, "name": "Bob", "role": "Developer", "department": "IT", "salary": 75000},
    {"id": 3, "name": "Charlie", "role": "Manager", "department": "Sales", "salary": 120000},
    {"id": 4, "name": "Diana", "role": "Designer", "department": "Marketing", "salary": 70000},
    {"id": 5, "name": "Evan", "role": "Analyst", "department": "Finance", "salary": 90000},
]

projects: List[Project] = [
    {"id": 101, "name": "Project Alpha", "department": "Sales", "budget": 300000, "spent": 75000, "status": "active"},
    {"id": 102, "name": "Project Beta", "department": "IT", "budget": 300000, "spent": 250000, "status": "completed"},

]

    return [e for e in employees if e["role"] == role]

def get_projects_by_status(status: str) -> List[Project]:
    return [p for p in projects if p["status"] == status]

    return project["budget"] - project["spent"] if project else 0.0

    return [p for p in projects if p["department"] == department and p["status"] == status]

    {"id": 102, "name": "Project Beta", "status": "active", "department": "Engineering", "budget": 8000.0},
    {"id": 103, "name": "Project Gamma", "status": "active", "department": "Engineering", "budget": 12000.0},
    {"id": 104, "name": "Project Delta", "status": "planning", "department": "HR", "budget": 20000.0}
]

def get_employees_by_department(department: str) -> list:
    """Retrieve employees by department."""
    return [e.copy() for e in employees if e["department"] == department]

def get_projects_by_status(status: str) -> list:
    """Retrieve projects by status."""
    return [p.copy() for p in projects if p["status"] == status]

def allocate_employee_to_project(employee_id: int, project_id: int) -> bool:
    """Allocate an unallocated employee to a project."""
    employee = next((e for e in employees if e["id"] == employee_id and not e["allocated"]), None)
    project = next((p for p in projects if p["id"] == project_id), None)
    
    if not employee or not project:
        return False
    
    employee["allocated"] = True
    project.setdefault("team", []).append(employee_id)
    return True

def calculate_remaining_budget(project_id: int, cost: float) -> float:
    """Deduct cost from project budget and return remaining amount."""
    project = next((p for p in projects if p["id"] == project_id), None)
    if not project or project["budget"] < cost:
        return -1.0
    project["budget"] -= cost
    return project["budget"]

metadata.env:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List

@dataclass
class Employee:
    id: int
    name: str
    department: str
    role: str
    salary: float

@dataclass
class Project:
    id: int
    name: str
    department: str
    budget: float
    status: str

employees = [
    Employee(1, "Alice", "Engineering", "senior developer", 95000.0),
    Employee(2, "Bob", "Engineering", "junior developer", 75000.0),
    Employee(3, "Charlie", "Engineering", "senior developer", 97000.0),
    Employee(4, "Diana", "Sales", "manager", 85000.0)
]

projects = [
    Project(1, "Alpha", "Engineering", 200000.0, "active"),
    Project(2, "Beta", "Engineering", 250000.0, "active"),
    Project(3, "Gamma", "Engineering", 300000.0, "planned"),
    Project(4, "Delta", "Sales", 150000.0, "active")
]

def get_employees_by_department(department: str) -> List[Employee]:
    return [e for e in employees if e.department == department]

def get_employees_by_role(role: str) -> List[Employee]:
    return [e for e in employees if e.role == role]

def get_projects_by_department(department: str) -> List[Project]:
    return [p for p in projects if p.department == department]

def get_projects_by_status(status: str) -> List[Project]:
    return [p for p in projects if p.status == status]

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

books_data = [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Python Programming", "author": "John Smith", "copies_available": 3, "reserved": False, "due_date": None},
    {"id": 2, "title": "Advanced Python", "author": "Sarah Lee", "copies_available": 1, "reserved": True, "due_date": datetime.today() - timedelta(days=2)},
    {"id": 3, "title": "Data Science with Python", "author": "Emma Brown", "copies_available": 0, "reserved": False, "due_date": datetime.today() + timedelta(days=7)}
]

def search_books(keyword: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Search books by title keyword"""
    return [b for b in books_data if keyword.lower() in b["title"].lower()]

def check_availability(book_id: int) -> dict:
    """Check availability of a specific book"""
    book = next((b for b in books_data if b["id"] == book_id), None)
    return {"available": book["copies_available"] > 0} if book else None

def reserve_book(book_id: int, user_id: str) -> str:
    """Reserve a book for a user"""
    book = next((b for b in books_data if b["id"] == book_id), None)
    if book and book["copies_available"] > 0:
        book["copies_available"] -= 1
        book["reserved"] = True
        return f"RES-{book_id}{user_id}"
    return None

def calculate_late_fee(book_id: int) -> float:
    """Calculate late fee based on overdue days"""
    book = next((b for b in books_data if b["id"] == book_id), None)
    if book and book["due_date"]:
        overdue_days = (datetime.today().date() - book["due_date"].date()).days
        return max(0, overdue_days) * 1.0  # $1 per day
    return 0.0

# Mocked environment for event planning system
from typing import List, Dict, TypedDict, Union

class Venue(TypedDict):
    name: str
    capacity: int
    available_dates: List[str]

class Caterer(TypedDict):
    name: str
    cuisine: str
    min_guests: int
    max_guests: int
    available_dates: List[str]

class Staff(TypedDict):
    name: str
    role: str
    available_dates: List[str]

venues: List[Venue] = [
    {"name": "Grand Hall", "capacity": 200, "available_dates": ["2023-12-15", "2023-12-16"]},
    {"name": "Sky Lounge", "capacity": 150, "available_dates": ["2023-12-14", "2023-12-16"]},
    {"name": "Convention Center", "capacity": 500, "available_dates": ["2023-12-15"]}
]

caterers: List[Caterer] = [
    {"name": "Gourmet Plus", "cuisine": "French", "min_guests": 50, "max_guests": 300, "available_dates": ["2023-12-14"]},
    {"name": "Mama Mia Catering", "cuisine": "Italian", "min_guests": 20, "max_guests": 200, "available_dates": ["2023-12-15"]},
    {"name": "Sushi Masters", "cuisine": "Japanese", "min_guests": 10, "max_guests": 100, "available_dates": ["2023-12-16"]}
]

staff: List[Staff] = [
    {"name": "Alice", "role": "manager", "available_dates": ["2023-12-15"]},
    {"name": "Bob", "role": "assistant", "available_dates": ["2023-12-15", "2023-12-16"]},
    {"name": "Charlie", "role": "assistant", "available_dates": ["2023-12-15"]},
    {"name": "Dave", "role": "coordinator", "available_dates": ["2023-12-14"]}
]

# Core functions
def get_venues_by_capacity(min_capacity: int) -> List[Venue]:
    """Filter venues by minimum capacity"""
    return [v for v in venues if v["capacity"] >= min_capacity]

def check_venue_availability(venue_name: str, date: str) -> bool:
    """Check venue availability for specific date"""
    venue = next((v for v in venues if v["name"] == venue_name), None)
    return venue and date in venue["available_dates"] if venue else False

def get_caterers_by_cuisine(cuisine: str) -> List[Caterer]:
    """Find caterers by cuisine type"""
    return [c for c in caterers if c["cuisine"].lower() == cuisine.lower()]

def check_caterer_availability(caterer_name: str, date: str) -> bool:
    """Check caterer availability for specific date"""
    caterer = next((c for c in caterers if c["name"] == caterer_name), None)
    return caterer and date in caterer["available_dates"] if caterer else False

def check_staff_availability(role: str, date: str) -> List[Staff]:
    """Find available staff by role for specific date"""
    return [s for s in staff if s["role"] == role and date in s["available_dates"]]

# Booking functions (stateful operations)
booked_venue: List[Venue] = []
booked_caterer: List[Caterer] = []
booked_staff: List[Staff] = []

def book_venue(venue_name: str) -> bool:
    """Book a venue by name"""
    venue = next((v for v in venues if v["name"] == venue_name), None)
    if venue and venue not in booked_venue:
        booked_venue.append(venue)
        return True
    return False

def book_caterer(caterer_name: str) -> bool:
    """Book a caterer by name"""
    caterer = next((c for c in caterers if c["name"] == caterer_name), None)
    if caterer and caterer not in booked_caterer:
        booked_caterer.append(caterer)
        return True
    return False

def book_staff(staff_name: str) -> bool:
    """Book staff member by name"""
    staff_member = next((s for s in staff if s["name"] == staff_name), None)
    if staff_member and staff_member not in booked_staff:
        booked_staff.append(staff_member)
        return True
    return False
